interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.24.0: bounded Windows shared-file replacement retries with revision and policy rechecks, opt-in bilingual tool-call matrices with literal identifier preservation and redacted receipts, and public-fixture Kiwi/qmd retrieval comparisons. A small fixed-budget Korean probe completed 0/4 canonical versus 4/4 literal-preserving tasks; vector recall improved on the fixture while producing 8/8 no-answer false positives. Published as a GitHub immutable release. Existing memory, diagnostics, budgets and Jarvis API-auth boundary remain. No default network/model call, optional dependency installation or automatic vault migration.
